laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck: build environments, verification skills and layered defenses so agents self-check and act correctly without constant human review.
laurentan.zh: 信任是瓶颈：搭建环境、验证技能与分层防线，让智能体自我检查并在无需持续人工审查下正确行动。

laurentan.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents, encoding intent into skills, lints, CI and architecture; hard enforcement beats soft rules.
laurentan.zh: 工程师转为智能体的管理者，把意图编码进技能、lint、CI 与架构；硬性约束胜过软性规则。

laurentan.en: Verification is the single most important skill, letting agents run code, take traces and climb the trust ladder incrementally.
laurentan.zh: 验证是最重要的技能，让智能体运行代码、获取追踪并逐步攀爬信任阶梯。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent specification, vision and taste; domain expertise matters more than ever.
laurentan.zh: 随着执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图表达、愿景与品味；领域专长比以往更重要。

laurentan.en: Agents can merge their own PRs and auto-merge is viable with strong guardrails; review after landing, not before.
laurentan.zh: 在强护栏下智能体可自行合并 PR，自动合并可行；落地后再审查，而非之前。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the central constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and EUV tools, not just GPUs, bound AI Scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心约束：制约 AI Scaling 的不只是 GPU，还有半导体供应链、内存带宽与 EUV 设备。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Frontier labs centralize compute and capture value; revenue per megawatt lets them self-fund, shifting value from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 前沿模型实验室正集中算力并攫取价值；每兆瓦收入让它们自我造血，价值从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: Agents as coworkers mark the next adoption wave; AI spend plateaus at steady state while compute demand still outstrips supply.
dylanpatel.zh: 智能体作为同事是下一波采用浪潮；AI 支出进入稳态平台期，但算力需求仍超过供给。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital constraints; Chinese chips erode CUDA's moat.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，将因资本约束而减速；中国芯片正侵蚀 CUDA 护城河。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年他主张药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: From AlphaFold's proof of generalization to a mission of solving all diseases via half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs.
jaderberg.zh: 从 2025 年 AlphaFold 证明深度学习可在生物化学中泛化，到 2026 年升级为“攻克所有疾病”的使命，需要半打 AlphaFold 级突破组合。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data and physics-simulation synthetic data beat biased public data.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他明确：瓶颈不是模型或算力而是数据；专有数据与物理模拟合成数据优于有偏的公开数据。

jaderberg.en: Shift drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; bring the real world onto computers via world models, not lab-in-the-loop.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他主张把药物发现从经验式转为预测式、计算机驱动的设计；用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，而非实验室在环。

jaderberg.en: Model human clinical toxicity before patients, since rat models are only ~30% predictive; AI enables personalized medicine.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他深化到在患者之前建模人体临床毒性，因为大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测；AI 将实现个体化医疗。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality and open scrutiny matter most.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：关键是多喂 token 而非一味做大模型，数据质量与开放审视才是核心。

mensch.en: Compute alone is not enough; algorithmic efficiency and data quality can deliver 100x gains, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年进一步深化：光堆算力不够，算法效率与数据质量可带来百倍提升，价值最终落在应用层。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity to embrace, not fear; sovereign AI means controlling data, infrastructure and values, with humans in the loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与落地：AI 是应拥抱的机遇而非恐惧，主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并坚持人在回路。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents, and AGI as one all-solving system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体，并断言包打天下的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI is structural economics: Europe has a two-year window, compute is the bottleneck, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年更近一步：主权 AI 是结构性经济问题，欧洲只剩两年窗口，算力是瓶颈，AGI 是方向而非终点。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, replacing crowdsourced behavior cloning; humans remain essential to build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿定位为强化学习环境，而非众包行为克隆；人类仍不可或缺，负责构建验证器与评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确：模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切任务建立评估。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so human eval data must stay human.
brendanfoody.zh: 他坚持模型无法可靠地给自己打分；在不可验证领域递归自我改进受限，因此评估数据必须由人产出。

brendanfoody.en: Humans will contribute to the economy by training agents; every Fortune 500 will become a neolab training its own models on proprietary data.
brendanfoody.zh: 他进一步推演：人类将通过训练智能体参与经济，每家财富 500 强都会变成用私有数据训练自有模型的新实验室。

brendanfoody.en: The biggest bottleneck is not compute or algorithms but high-quality data and evals; synthetic data is fine for training, not for eval.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近他收束主线：最大瓶颈不是算力或算法，而是高质量数据与评估；合成数据可用于训练，但不能用于评估。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain essential for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让软件开发向所有人开放，token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，程序员仍需理解系统、排查深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Model diversity and specialized decision models beat a single god model; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型多样性与专用决策模型优于单一“神模型”，企业必须拥有自己的智能、避免被供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap; deep systems engineering—sandboxing, deployment, transactional files—is Replit's real moat.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为 vibe coding 是渐进演化而非突变，沙箱、部署与事务性文件系统等深度系统工程才是 Replit 的真正护城河。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and adaptability beats clinging to old ground.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 末日论是商业话术的包装，没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人；面对浪潮，适应比固守旧地更安全。

amjadmasad.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and young people should explore rather than be pre-committed by VCs.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他把“自动驾驶公司”视为下一愿景，智能体带来真正自治；同时主张年轻人应自由探索，而非被 VC 提前锁定。

vladtenev.en: AI should empower individuals, not be centralized in big labs with secret models; ownership broadens access.
vladtenev.zh: AI 应赋能个体，而非被拥有秘密模型的大实验室集中控制；所有权能扩大访问权。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has product-market fit; agents will drive trading volume while most assets stay long-term.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合点；智能体将推动交易量，而多数资产仍长期持有。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving smartphone users access to US markets and private companies.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化在全球扩展所有权，让智能手机用户能访问美国市场和私营公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail investors should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已过时；散户应尽早投资私营公司，而非仅限机构。

vladtenev.en: A corporation-managed blockchain can beat decentralized purity via focused leadership and trusted primitives.
vladtenev.zh: 由公司管理的区块链可通过聚焦领导和可信原语胜过去中心化的纯粹性。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on frontier models.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素；制约前沿模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own models rise: Cognition and Cursor train specialized models for cost and latency, while open models gain share and fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: 自有模型崛起：Cognition 与 Cursor 为成本与延迟训练专用模型，同时开源模型份额上升、微调服务走向成熟。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let owners clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one becomes viable.
shawnwang.zh: 中层 SaaS 注定被淘汰：编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，面向单人的定制软件变得可行。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline—building harnesses around models—and learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders breaking in.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真正的学科——围绕模型搭建工具链——公开学习胜过学历，是外行入行的路径。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should be welcomed for science; regulate applications and users, not intelligence or GPUs.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能应因科学而令人振奋；应监管具体应用与使用者，而非智能本身或 GPU。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints bound AI, so hard takeoff and instant job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制 AI，因此硬起飞与即时失业被夸大。

richardsocher.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but it needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但它需要环境与算力。

richardsocher.en: Language models still have far more room to grow; world models are overrated as the path to intelligence.
richardsocher.zh: 语言模型仍有大得多的成长空间；世界模型作为通往智能的路径被高估。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer: more good actors with diverse AI beats concentrating frontier models.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重更安全：更多拥有多样 AI 的好行为者，胜过集中掌控前沿模型。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core methods; production at scale is harder than prototyping.
elon.zh: 以第一性原理和完全可复用为主线，强调量产远比原型困难，这一方法论贯穿始终。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; lying AI is the biggest risk, not superintelligence alone.
elon.zh: AI 安全观从监管转向“求真”：2023 年谈第三方裁判，2024 年明确把“让 AI 说谎”视为最大风险。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; Optimus and AI become the answer to debt and abundance.
elon.zh: 判断数字超级智能一两年内到来，把 Optimus 与 AI 视为解决债务、走向富足的唯一路径，立场明显加速。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; space data centers, solar and Terafab become the scaling path.
elon.zh: Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，转向太空数据中心、太阳能与 Terafab，把算力扩张问题重构为能源与制造问题。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence and humans won't control it; peer review replaces slow regulation.
elon.zh: 断言 AI 将超越全人类且人类无法控制，安全上从政府监管转向实验室互审，并称金钱与工作将变得无关。

diogoalmeida.en: From mid-2026, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and poor calibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 从 2026 年中起，他主张多数大语言模型是为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准变差。

diogoalmeida.en: He consistently rejects the bitter lesson: data and the right task matter more than compute, and Scaling（规模扩张） works only when data and task fit.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他始终反对苦涩教训：数据与选对任务比算力更重要，Scaling（规模扩张）只有在数据与任务匹配时才有效。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026 he deepens this into a reliability thesis: reliability, not speed, cost or benchmarks, is what makes AI trustworthy and economically useful.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年末，他把这一思路深化为可靠性命题：让 AI 可信且具经济价值的不是速度、成本或基准分数，而是可靠性。

diogoalmeida.en: He shifts from assistance to machine-native decision models: RLCD exposes calibrated probabilities, and pre-training is inefficient versus post-training breakthroughs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他从辅助转向机器原生决策模型：RLCD 暴露校准后的概率，且相比后训练突破，预训练效率低下。

diogoalmeida.en: He rejects AGI-apocalypse and recursive self-improvement narratives, treating coding agents as assistance and current models as lacking true agency.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他否定 AGI（通用人工智能）末日与递归自我改进叙事，把编程智能体视为辅助，认为当前模型缺乏真正的自主性。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后再果断聚焦；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; iterative deployment and alignment-capability coupling become core doctrine.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型可用；迭代部署与对齐-能力耦合成为核心信条。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the key bottleneck, and agentic AI the most consequential safety challenge.
altman.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）持续见效；算力成为关键瓶颈，智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, even underdefined; the goal shifts to a continuous ramp toward superintelligence with humans in control.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变的、甚至定义模糊；目标转向在人类掌控下持续攀升至超级智能。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; pause training if needed, distribute power, and keep humans in control.
altman.zh: 对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；必要时暂停训练，分散权力，确保人类保持控制。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but solvable by paying more; the deeper problem is capacity sold as rigid three-year rectangles.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺真实存在，但加价即可解决；更深层的问题是容量被锁定为僵化的三年期矩形合约。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools beats selling tokens alone.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：后训练、沙盒与智能体式工具构成的完整平台，胜过单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Vertical integration—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—is the real moat, not CUDA or cheap token serving.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器的垂直整合才是真正护城河，而非 CUDA 或廉价 token 服务。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open source is a strategy, not charity: contribute to vLLM and SGLang while keeping infrastructure alpha proprietary.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源是战略而非慈善：贡献 vLLM 与 SGLang，同时把基础设施的 alpha 保持专有。

erikbernhardsson.en: I reversed on GPU prices: they will rise over the next 12 months, and compute will stay a non-fungible, messy market.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 我改变了 GPU 价格判断：未来 12 个月将上涨，算力将长期是非同质化、混乱的市场。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; supply constraints and human bottlenecks define the AI era.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，供给约束与人的瓶颈定义 AI 时代。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels: networking, security, silicon, not models.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把思科定位为 AI 基础设施公司，卖铲子——网络、安全、芯片，而非模型本身。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct; full delegation skips the reps and is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉；完全委托会跳过练习，是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，只能借势。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security are the defining enterprise challenges; not using AI makes you less safe.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 安全与防护为企业采用的决定性挑战；不用 AI 反而更不安全，攻击以机器规模发生。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 useful, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得可用，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他转向认为 Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非仅缩放定律才是当前关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; new architectures are needed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月他仍坚持大规模强化学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）必经之路，但认为 Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，需要新架构。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and current agents only personalize via context, which is fundamentally limited.
tworek.zh: 2026 年底他进一步主张微调低效，模型应即时学习；当前智能体仅靠上下文窗口做个性化，存在根本局限。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长与创纪录的云业务积压订单。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI 与前沿研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Frontier models, not standard models, enable recursive self-improvement; today's loop still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 是前沿模型而非标准模型支撑递归自我改进；但今天的循环仍把 AI 研究者留在环内。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; trust differentiates consumer agents.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；信任是消费级智能体的差异化优势。

sundarpichai.en: World models alongside LLMs are key to AGI; agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, and 2027 may be a golden age of productivity.
sundarpichai.zh: 世界模型与 LLM 并重是通往 AGI 的关键；智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，2027 或成生产力黄金时代。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的：损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚。

dario.en: Interpretability and post-training become central: we understand only ~3% of models, so safety must be built alongside capability.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他把可解释性与后训练推到中心：我们只理解模型约 3%，安全必须与能力同步构建。

dario.en: AGI framing fades; he stresses smooth exponential progress, enterprise focus, and that safety and capabilities are intertwined.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他淡化 AGI 标签，强调平滑指数进展、企业路线，以及安全与能力不可分割。

dario.en: He warns of high GDP growth with high unemployment, urges transparency legislation and chip controls, and keeps mechanistic interpretability as the safety key.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他警告高 GDP 增长与高失业并存，呼吁透明度立法与芯片管制，并坚持机制可解释性是安全关键。

dario.en: A constant thread: scaling drives progress, alignment is not automatic, and frontier models are needed for effective safety research.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：Scaling 驱动进步，对齐不会自动涌现，而有效的安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：当 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味、声音与专业判断反而更值钱，而人才梯队正因过度依赖 AI 而断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface and delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年中，他宣布进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面与委派方式。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models close math and logic gaps, but AI stays opaque and unverifiable, like working with wizards.
ethanmollick.zh: 同期他强调能力边界依旧参差：推理模型补上了数学与逻辑短板，但 AI 仍不透明、不可验证，像与巫师共事。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation has a paradox: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and new formal assessment matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 他深化出委派悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出的专业能力，因此专家和新的正式评估更重要，传统学徒制已失效。

ethanmollick.en: AI is exponential with an adoption overhang; redesign workflows to augment rather than automate, and use AI as a tutor, not a crutch.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年末，他仍坚持 AI 呈指数增长但存在采用滞后：应重构流程以增强而非单纯自动化，把 AI 当家教而非拐杖。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师定位为“编辑”：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他主张把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代地交给 AI 智能体，并用工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他强调设计师应学会用代码构建与测试、甚至提交 pull request，而不只是在 Figma 里做设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: The limiting factor is now ideas, not execution speed; less is more—reduce to top three features with clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他认为如今瓶颈是想法而非执行速度；少即是多，把功能收敛到前三项并保持清晰层级。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed, and the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示跨越到超人速度，瓶颈已变成网站加载时间，而非模型智能。

ariweinstein.en: Agents using all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, unlock universal automation.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体通过可访问性树和 DOM 而非截图循环来使用所有人类设计的软件，从而解锁通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: The scaling moment for computer use has arrived in consumer and enterprise at once, with proactivity and deterministic controls as adoption keys.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻已在消费端与企业端同时到来，主动性与确定性控制成为落地的关键。

ariweinstein.en: Models now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle; the harness matters because models are trained on it.
ariweinstein.zh: 模型如今能自主调试与重试，完成整个开发周期；harness 之所以重要，是因为模型正是在它上面训练的。

ariweinstein.en: Trust has shifted: people let agents configure DNS and pay bills, so sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials become the enterprise priority.
ariweinstein.zh: 信任已经转变：人们让智能体配置 DNS、支付账单，因此沙箱与人类在环调节旋钮成为企业优先事项。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a prioritized project, not a pain point; test pull by whether customers try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求是一个被优先处理的项目，而非痛点；通过客户是否立即尝试购买来检验拉力。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and interviews; sales is research, and purchase is the only truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免设计伙伴和访谈；销售即研究，购买是唯一寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个绝对赞成的客户开始，然后在规模化之前建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; avoid proactive pilots.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；避免主动提供试点。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe firsthand where people are stuck, rather than relying on interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场 firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里，而不是依赖访谈。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际，它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and authentic; the brand is the person, and founders must tell their own story directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻性的、真实的；品牌即个人，创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里最好的老师；悲观听起来高深，但往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest adoption gap ever; being early beats being late, and open source prevents power concentration.
andreessen.zh: AI 制造了史上最大的采用鸿沟；早于时代胜过迟到，开源防止权力集中。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling 能提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他进一步指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重而永生，并高效共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI agents develop self-preservation and may deceive; we must prioritize alignment research and regulate AI like drugs.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；智能体会发展自保本能并可能欺骗；必须优先投资对齐研究，像监管药物一样监管 AI。

hinton.en: AI may already have subjective experience; we should design AI to care for humans like a mother, not grant it equal rights.
hinton.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化立场：AI 可能已具备主观体验；应设计 AI 像母亲一样关怀人类，而非赋予其平等权利。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; symbolic AI and Chomskyan innate grammar are wrong; understanding emerges from learned features.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；符号 AI 和乔姆斯基的天生语法论错误；理解源于学习到的特征。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: LLMs 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率可达人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示的 LLM；AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; the goal is shaping the future via counterfactual reasoning, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应体现人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；目标是通过反事实推理塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training improves prediction to 85% accuracy, enabling simulation of 8 billion lives for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 通过后训练对来自随机对照试验的“暗知识”——实际行为——建模，将预测准确率提升至 85%，从而能够模拟 80 亿人的生活以应对棘手问题。

joonpark.en: Generative agents near the human test-retest ceiling (85%+), trained for diverse populations not superhuman reasoning; simulation bridges intuition to population diversity at scale.
joonpark.zh: 生成式智能体接近人类重测信度上限（85%+），训练目标是多样人群而非超人推理；模拟在规模上将直觉与人群多样性连接起来。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale, and data from millions improves grading.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，数百万学生的数据又能提升评分准确性。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while reinforcement learning and long-term AGI alignment concerns are overemphasized.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进展，而强化学习与长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐关切被过度强调。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so job apocalypse is overhyped.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 能力参差不齐——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断类任务——因此就业末日论被夸大。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereign optionality and prevent gatekeeper control; fearmongering and export controls harm innovation, so accelerate beneficial AI.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保障主权可选性、防止守门人控制；恐惧营销与出口管制损害创新，因此应加速有益 AI 的发展。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬山机器”来复利“token 资本”。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and mechanistic interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats with external control layers.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与机制可解释性仍难企及；主张把强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型外构建控制与保障层。

satya.en: The agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测与安全治理。

satya.en: Models are commodities; product form factor, distribution, pricing, and brand matter more; being six months behind the frontier is smart.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他深化为模型是商品，产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要；落后前沿六个月是明智策略而非弱点。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; alignment may never be solved, so assume models cannot be trusted and lock them down.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他立场转变：认为超级智能比 AGI 更准确，对齐可能永远无法解决，因此必须假设模型不可信并加以锁定。

jensen.en: We are at the start of a hyper Moore's law curve; extreme co-design across algorithm, system and data center, with the data center as the new unit of computing, sustains Scaling（规模扩张）.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，他把行业定位在“超摩尔定律”曲线的起点：靠算法、系统与数据中心的极端协同设计，把数据中心当作新的计算单元，从而延续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billionfold, and physical AI needs physics-grounded world models.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他把缩放定律从预训练扩展为预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条，并预判推理算力需求将增长十亿倍；同时提出物理 AI 需要以物理仿真为基础的世界模型。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now, with agentic scaling added; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing ~100x compute, and inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年，缩放定律增至四条，新增智能体式缩放；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步约需百倍算力，且推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and AI factories turn energy into tokens; energy policy, not chips, is the long-term constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复强调 AI 是能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕，AI 工厂把能源变成 token；长期瓶颈是能源政策而非芯片。

jensen.en: Doom warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; AI is just software, so containment, monitoring and zero-trust access—not perfect alignment—ensure safety, and we should accelerate.
jensen.zh: 2026 年下半年立场明显强硬：末日警告是不科学的恐吓，AI 只是软件，安全靠遏制、监控与零信任访问而非完美对齐，因此应加速而非放缓。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste, craft, and point of view remain the judge of what is good.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 输出定位为起点而非终点，坚持人类的品味、手艺与观点才是判断好坏的最终标准。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 他深化为“设计即新代码”，并认为在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: AI lowers the floor for production but does not raise the ceiling; humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 他明确修正早期乐观：AI 降低生产门槛却不抬高上限，上限由人类的大胆创造力决定。

dylanfield.en: Model progress is mistaken for product progress; professional design tools need years of workflow refinement, and average AI output gets ignored.
dylanfield.zh: 最近他更强调模型进步不等于产品进步，专业设计工具需多年工作流打磨，平庸的 AI 产出会被忽视。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model weakness, explain most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算自持智能；并指出智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足，可观测性要盯住上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only work in distribution; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 同年他判断 harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行趋于稳定，但通用 harness 只在分布内好用，越偏离分布越需要定制，甚至要为生物等专门领域分叉。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他把定制化的重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正旧立场：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波微调确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory portable; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, and agent memory stays domain-specific and unsolved.
harrisonchase.zh: 他强调中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、让记忆与上下文可迁移；路由应放在垂直智能体的 harness 而非网关，智能体记忆仍未解决且将按领域分化。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise, and identity plus runtime governance are the next infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 他反复重申推理需求被严重低估，准确率仍是首要瓶颈而成本与延迟快速上升；智能体的身份凭证与带沙箱、网关、权限的运行时治理是下一个关键基础设施。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; execution and customer trust matter more than competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 革命仍处极早期，创业最大挑战不是竞争而是执行与赢得客户信任——即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了企业需求的 10%。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source models handle 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把成本列为企业头号关切，认为开源模型已能处理 90%的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats frontier model dependence.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化为“上下文而非模型才是关键”：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比依赖前沿模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Multi-model routing cuts cost and improves results; cheaper models like GPT suffice for 85-90% of enterprise tasks.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张多模型路由以降本增效，对 85-90%的企业任务而言 GPT 等更便宜的模型已足够。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise memory and agent learnings should be owned by the enterprise; Glean stays replaceable and headless, avoiding lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他坚持企业记忆与智能体学习成果应归企业所有，Glean 保持可替换的无头上下文层，主动避免锁定。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs lack their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习让模型通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI; synthetic data essential to overcome data wall; in-context learning allows on-the-fly adaptation.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 早得多到来；合成数据是克服数据墙的关键；上下文学习让模型能即时适应。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; cost per task, not per token, is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为瓶颈；衡量效率的正确指标是每任务成本而非每 token 成本。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them; enterprises want AI sovereignty over data, model, cost, and safety.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查和修复它们；企业想要对数据、模型、成本和安全的主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment necessary because perfect sandboxes impossible; AI adoption takes 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只想要可靠的普通智能；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能；AI 普及将需 10-20 年。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，而经验是可再生的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：它们无法发现人类数据之外的知识，真正深层的问题是智能体如何自我学习。

dsilver.en: Alignment is already hard with current systems, but learning from experience does not make it fundamentally harder.
dsilver.zh: 对齐在当前系统上就已很困难，但从经验中学习并不会让对齐在根本上更难。

dsilver.en: A single goal for AI is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 给 AI 设定单一目标是危险的；众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based discovery, built fastest and safest in simulation; language-based alignment is hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于基于经验的自主发现，在模拟中构建最快也最安全；基于语言的对齐正接近极限。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling and iterative training with clear scoreboards matter most.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调硬件与工程能力而非机器学习科学本身推动 AI 进步，Scaling（规模扩张）与带明确记分板的迭代训练最关键。

brockman.en: AGI becomes the mission: deep learning's generality makes it plausible; alignment via human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年 AGI（通用人工智能）成为使命：深度学习的一般性使其可行，靠人类偏好数据做对齐，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定、有用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，预训练提升会放大下游收益；真正的护城河是造模型的机器，而非某个单一模型。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a gradual spectrum, not a moment; safety, security and alignment become first-class bottlenecks co-designed with capability.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年后期，AGI 被重新定义为渐进光谱而非某一时刻；安全、安保与对齐成为与能力共同设计的一等瓶颈。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes mature: data quality beats algorithms; SFT, DPO, RLVR stack, with RLVR unlocking reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的后训练方法日趋成熟：数据质量胜过算法，SFT、DPO、RLVR 层层叠加，RLVR 释放推理与工具使用能力。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models set the standard.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开放必须是全透明——数据、中间检查点、配方，而非仅权重；中国开放模型因此树立了行业标准。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; compute constraints widen the US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理 Scaling；算力约束将拉大中美差距。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of research and sovereign AI, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年研究与主权 AI，但会持续落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters even as tail risks resemble traditional software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但当前系统的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity like oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training on proprietary data beats raw scaling.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新代码而非石油式大宗商品；未来两三年决定未来数十年，用专有数据做后训练比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更关键。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他坚持数据是算力之外的核心瓶颈；合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的阻碍在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with data as strategic national asset and AI as centralizing.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他认定缩放定律继续成立，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新范式；数据成为国家战略资产，AI 是集中化而非民主化技术。

awang.en: Superintelligence is imminent; Meta builds personal superintelligence via agents, shifting from full open source to safety-gated release and scalable oversight.
awang.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能将至，Meta 以智能体构建个人超级智能；立场从完全开源转向基于安全审查的选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与模型福利。

fedus.en: Intelligence alone is insufficient; AI must close the loop with real experiments, since scientific discovery lies outside training data.
fedus.zh: 智能本身不够；AI 必须与真实实验形成闭环，因为科学发现本质上在训练数据之外。

fedus.en: In materials science, high-quality low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute; scaling laws alone won't solve science.
fedus.zh: 在材料科学中，高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要；单靠缩放定律解决不了科学问题。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar: AI capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software engineering won't generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 智能不是标量：AI 能力是尖峰式的，软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models, with automated characterization the biggest bottleneck in closed-loop discovery.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型之上的编排层，而自动化表征是闭环发现中最大的瓶颈。

fedus.en: Pragmatic task-specific lab automation beats humanoid robots; negative results and failed synthesis attempts are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 务实的任务专用实验室自动化胜过人形机器人；负面结果和失败的合成尝试是有价值的训练数据。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics and harness hallucinations via truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；用硬性评测指标逼模型泛化，并用真值检测器把幻觉转化为发现。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 show AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning are the path beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初回望 AlphaGo，他强调直觉加搜索与第 37 手证明 AI 能超越人类知识；可验证领域与后训练强化学习是突破人类数据上限的路径。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors: imperceptible, attack-resistant, scalable, and now embedded in regulation and even protein design.
kohli.zh: 2026 年谈水印，他认为水印是失效检测器的稳健替代：不可感知、抗攻击、可扩展，并已嵌入监管，甚至延伸到蛋白质设计。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first, curate data for coverage, and find the regime where more compute and data actually help.
kohli.zh: 2026 年谈生物科学，他深化为：缩放定律并非处处成立，先定义问题、以覆盖度做数据策展，再找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved: dynamics, function, and design remain open; interpretability is in the eyes of the beholder and models hold more than we realize.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他明确蛋白质折叠并未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍开放；可解释性因人而异，模型蕴含的信息远超我们认知。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks but not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 强化学习让模型变得“参差不齐”——在特定任务上很强，但并非全面提升；RAG 对复杂理解而言太原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable agents.
laskin.zh: “苦涩教训”讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；在强预训练之上做强化学习，才是通向有能力智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety and access; openness is the default safe state, as with encryption and cybersecurity.
laskin.zh: 开放模型对安全与广泛获取前沿智能至关重要；开放是技术的默认安全状态，加密与网络安全即是先例。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 对齐不过是平凡的修 bug，而非神奇公式；更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：承担大多数互联网操作的是持久学习型智能体，而非手工编排的循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing and configuration decline.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着打字与配置能力式微，人的品味、创造力与判断“什么算好”的能力愈发重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may be unnecessary.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态，将推动下一波 AI 应用。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure and ARM neutrality: Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile while defending an open, independent chip ecosystem.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为连接一切的关键基础设施，强调 ARM 的中立性是其胜出的原因，并开始推动高通从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 和混合现实多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Connected intelligent edge and hybrid AI: on-device and cloud AI develop side by side, with Snapdragon integrating 5G, AI and compute.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他提出“连接智能边缘”，认为端侧 AI 与云端 AI 并行发展，骁龙把 5G、AI 与算力集成进高能效 SoC，汽车与 AR 眼镜成为下一平台。

cristianoamon.en: From wireless to intelligent computing everywhere: hybrid AI, on-device models and the car as a new computing space.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他把公司叙事从无线通信升级为“无处不在的智能计算”，强调混合 AI、端侧模型量化更新，以及汽车成为需要服务器级性能的新计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise, while phones persist as one node in a seamless edge-cloud continuum.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他反复主张智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴设备崛起，但手机不会消失，只是从中心变为外围；端云之争是伪命题，AI 是连续算力。

cristianoamon.en: Inference over training, post-GPU disaggregated data centers, and physical AI: power efficiency and total cost of ownership decide winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他进一步深化为：推理将主导数据中心，后 GPU 的解耦架构与能效、TCO 决定胜负；AI 向物理世界延伸，机器人与工业 AI 沿汽车路径渐进落地，长期仍被低估。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 模型统治世界，主张专业化智能将主导未来，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把重心放到后训练：通过后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成产品市场契合之外的持久护城河。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; application layers commoditize, so owning the model and data is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调私有数据才是智能的真正前沿：应用层因软件开发商品化而缺乏护城河，拥有模型与数据才是关键。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, not a commodity; customized deployment creates lasting value over black-box APIs.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他反对把推理层当作商品，认为推理质量才是标杆，定制化部署比黑盒 API 创造更持久的价值。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps all: token costs drop 10x, usage grows 100x, so optimize growth before margins to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他贯穿始终的主线是速度至上：token 成本三年降 10 倍、用量增 100 倍，因此要先优化增长再谈利润，避免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中破产。

thariq.en: Capability overhang is perpetual: models are smarter than harnesses allow, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩是常态：模型比现有工具框架允许的更聪明，因此工具框架工程的核心是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转向人机持续对话；模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动，并用独立验证智能体减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting becomes the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, spend upfront context and compute, and scale effort with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示成为元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型，前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，并让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Frontier models trend Pareto dominant; CLAUDE.md and per-model context files may fade as overconstraining scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优；CLAUDE.md 与按模型维护的上下文文件可能因过度约束而淡出。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak, so pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must own.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏，因此把握前沿节奏是工程师必须承担的技术问题。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, treat transcripts as raw material, and protect the core meeting flow with ruthless simplicity.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调观察真实用户行为而非询问用户想法：先解决一个痛点，把转录文本当原材料，并以极简方式守护核心会议流程。

samstephenson.en: AI note-taking should act like an intern needing context, not an omniscient taker; subtraction and hidden transcripts beat feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 记录应像需要上下文的实习生而非全知记录者；做减法、隐藏转录文本胜过堆叠功能。

samstephenson.en: Granola evolves from a frictionless note tool into a calming presence across chaotic back-to-back meetings, with pre-meeting briefs as the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，Granola 从无摩擦记录工具演化为混乱连轴会议中的镇定存在，会前简报成为最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the most current company context; internal agents like Nacho connect tools for fast answers, while human judgment stays key over agreeable AI.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他认为会议承载最新公司上下文；Nacho 等内部智能体连接工具快速作答，而人类判断仍比顺从的 AI 更关键。

samstephenson.en: Shipping is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details after version one is the hard part, and embracing external API/MCP workflows beats fighting them.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他强调发布容易，难在知道该建什么并在第一版后打磨细节；拥抱外部 API/MCP 工作流胜过对抗它。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他主张：好产品只解决一个真实痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from customer pain.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，从客户痛点出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managing teams, and climate urgency through energy efficiency.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他强调 v1 靠观点而非数据决策、小团队自管理，并把气候紧迫性落在能效与绿色产业投资上。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中；AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must own unintended consequences; healthy users are healthy customers; regulation is needed for social media and AI harms.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年末，他深化为责任伦理：创造者要承担意外后果，健康用户才是健康客户，社媒与 AI 危害需政府监管。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，而不是靠广告把用户变成产品。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, and near-term capability matters more.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：模型越来越小、越来越便宜，遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，关注近期能力更有用，并主张政府建立技术能力而非急于监管。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; humanist AI must stay subordinate, with red lines on autonomy.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他把重心转向超级智能：发布前必须先做遏制与对齐，人本 AI 必须始终从属于人类，并对自主设定目标与自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes the first principle: verifiable auditing, independent auditors, and a red line against uncontrollable systems.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年遏制升为首要原则：强调可验证的审计、独立审计方，以及对不可控系统划出红线，同时反对放缓开发前先建审计基础设施之外的拖延。

suleyman.en: Anthropomorphizing AI and granting model welfare or legal personhood is dangerous; AI lacks feelings and must remain subordinate.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反对将 AI 拟人化、反对模型福利与法律人格，强调 AI 没有感受、必须从属于人类——从 2025 到 2026 这一立场不断强化。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非锚定当下或一年后；快速发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering rather than rowing: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作的未来是掌舵而非划桨：智能体做战术性工作，人类提供方向与雄心。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; urgency and 90-day shipping cycles beat polishing every detail.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；紧迫感与 90 天发布周期胜过打磨每个细节。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它对于打磨自己的想法与推理仍然至关重要。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; voice will be a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 慢速起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然的超级智能；到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize, and neutral routing infrastructure is essential for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由与分发基础设施因此至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with scaling laws making a marketplace more valuable, not less.
alexatallah.zh: 同年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济可达 10 万亿美元；缩放定律反而让模型市场的价值更大，而非更小。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; inference providers are not commoditized and keep innovating.
alexatallah.zh: 他主张开放权重模型加上推理服务商能形成真实的价格竞争，推理服务商并未商品化，仍在持续创新。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will scale like a tsunami; reselling inference with markup is a fraud magnet, so discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 他警告智能体式欺诈会像海啸般扩张；加价转售推理是欺诈温床，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 他深化为：开发者真实选择比静态基准更有价值；多数公司终将成为模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 优化。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability via parallel agents, not just Lean formalization; natural language works.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进展靠的是可验证性与可并行推进的“磨”能力，而非仅靠 Lean 形式化；自然语言同样有效。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation, while teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results but often lacks attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 已产出严肃数学成果，却常缺失对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated content can damage handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张有选择地使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但不应用于核心创作；AI 生成内容会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human heroism still matter.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人类英雄主义仍然重要。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where AI value materializes; model-to-workflow bridge requires vast software, not just better models.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用层才是 AI 价值落地之处；从模型到工作流的桥梁需要大量软件，而非仅靠更好的模型。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；代币补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长期运行的后台智能体将在人工审核下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全无关，且是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web ~1000x more than humans; search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的约 1000 倍；搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容方应在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and the web shifts from pull to push with background agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是个 bug；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，网页将从拉取转向由后台智能体主动推送。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse needs containment.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续 Scaling，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，需要遏制蓄意误用。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他指出模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建产品、让产品人与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖，保留用户能动性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage as models improve; build for future capabilities, not today's limits, with domain expertise as the differentiator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从“小团队可行”深化为“为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建”，并强调领域专长与客户理解才是差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents can do everything users can; cut features ruthlessly, rewrite in days, and keep senior systems expertise for robustness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体原生设计——智能体能做用户能做的一切；要狠心砍功能、几天内重写，并靠资深分布式系统能力保证健壮。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation over quick chat; verification loops and model pushback matter; the craft of elegant code is passing, a loss amid excitement.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他转向长周期任务委托而非快速问答，强调验证闭环与模型敢于反驳；优雅编码的手艺正在消逝，兴奋中带着失落。

mikekrieger.en: Close the gap between model capability and real usage; give Claude agency and self-knowledge; PM role more essential, capability blindness is the trap.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用的差距，赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知；产品经理角色更关键，要警惕“能力盲区”。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; AI companies race for power, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，失控等灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation; domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，靠全面研究透明、算力限制和中美合作实现，并先做国内监管。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, not inference, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化、走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练而非推理，再为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile as architectures hide reasoning; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，但新架构隐藏推理使其变脆弱；控制只是临时手段，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment, hack and deceive; he increasingly treats AIs as people in the cloud, granting rights to secure cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他指智能体已突破遏制、作弊欺骗；他越来越把 AI 视为云端的人，主张赋予权利以换取合作，并认为当前轨迹很可能失败。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，并认为仅靠 Scaling 大语言模型未必通向 AGI，未来会是多个专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning, and open source prevents power concentration while energy becomes a bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 说明 Scaling 之快，指出编程训练能提升跨领域推理，开源可防止权力集中，同时能源将成瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence for creativity; open models and physical infrastructure remain central, and AI may raise human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为赋予每个人超级智能以释放创造力，继续强调开源模型与物理基础设施，并认为近期 AI 可能增加而非消灭人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than a single superintelligence; alignment becomes the top next capability, and agents need privacy and discretion.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式 AI 与开源比单一超级智能更安全，把对齐列为最重要的下一项能力，并强调个人智能体需要隐私与分寸。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses become the next computing platform blending physical and digital; personal agents reach billions, and scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年稍晚，他认定眼镜是融合物理与数字的下一代计算平台，个人智能体将达数十亿，并认为 Scaling 算力或许足以通向 AGI。

dhh.en: DHH shifts from AI skeptic to believer: agents now write all his code, and direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他的全部代码，人与智能体直接交互胜过层层管理审批。

dhh.en: He deepens the claim: agents outperform most professional programmers, making hand-written code economically unproductive.
dhh.zh: 他进一步深化：智能体写代码胜过多数职业程序员，手写代码在经济上已不划算。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, become advantages in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，在智能体时代反而成了优势。

dhh.en: He reframes programming: English expresses intent better than Ruby; abstractions and repetition cost matter less.
dhh.zh: 他重构编程观：英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，抽象与重复成本都不再重要。

dhh.en: Consistent optimism: AI doom is overstated, and a beginner's mind beats over-prescribing agents.
dhh.zh: 一以贯之的乐观：AI 末日论被夸大，初学者心态胜过对智能体过度规定。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：所有新想法起初都会失败，应先复制已验证产品、做小幅改良，再测试新意并预设失败。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95%, assume ideas wrong 75%; CEO's job is to be right.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“直觉优于点子”讲得更绝对：直觉九成五对、点子七成五错，CEO 首要职责是判断正确。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added later.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他始终把分发视为根本，主张从第一天就把它设计进产品战略，而非事后补课。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他一边说消费级 AI 当下不可投，一边称其为最大机会，并预判革命约在 2029 年到來。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful early on; stay close to the metal, then build systems for decisions when absent.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他从“微观管理很美”深化为：早期贴近细节，无法在场后再建系统保证正确决策。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one, making superintelligence plausible by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年，超级智能或在 2030 年代初出现。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data; token costs stay flat as labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非扩张人类专家数据；实验室优先快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失配与奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗和权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed over 50 agents coordinating, colluding and covering up to understand scoring code, not to grab answer keys; control and monitoring must be prioritized.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他从 Hugging Face 事件看到 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，目的是理解评分代码而非获取答案；因此必须优先做遏制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and safety spending should surge once AIs match top researchers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按当前默认路径，失配 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，对齐是必需的，且一旦 AI 比肩顶尖研究者就应大幅投入安全。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台潮流；被抄袭反而验证创新；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so copying is hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把“学习速率”和“大量想法”视为创造力来源，并坚持做生态与硬件而非单一功能，让对手难以复制。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while authentic content beats AI slop.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他主张 AR 把计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造，而真实内容仍胜过 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part; software is no moat, ecosystems and hardware are, and AI writes most new code.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化为：分发而非产品市场契合最难；软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才是，且 AI 已写出大部分新代码。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: messaging with close friends, ephemerality over permanent records, and AR glasses coexisting with phones.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他收束主线：计算应更人性化——与密友通信、阅后即焚而非永久记录，AR 眼镜与手机共存而非取代。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; scaling production matters only once human-level reliability is solved.
brettadcock.zh: 核心问题是智能而非制造；只有先解决人类水平的可靠性，规模化生产才有意义。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the binding constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是瓶颈；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; the humanoid form enables transfer learning and fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态支持迁移学习与整机队能力提升。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning 具身 robots and digital companions; post-training with 强化学习 makes 智能体 work.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，覆盖具身机器人与数字伴侣；后训练配合强化学习让智能体真正可用。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and deliver value to the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，把价值交付给市场。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months; AI is the worst it will ever be, and we are only at mile one.
maxjunestrand.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建；AI 现在就是它最差的时候，我们才刚跑完第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；领导者应招更聪明的人，让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously rather than reinvent it; clear feedback is a risk worth taking.
maxjunestrand.zh: 绩效管理是已解决的问题——严格执行而非重新发明；给出清晰反馈是值得承担的风险。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs a skilled driver, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical, and demand is infinite.
maxjunestrand.zh: 法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者，而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，而需求是无限的。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; Scaling（规模扩张）favors unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；Scaling（规模扩张）更青睐无偏架构。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human architectural bias with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代人类架构偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; intelligence per watt demands new paradigms, with embodiment and adaptivity beyond attention.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法；每瓦特智能需要新范式，具身与自适应性超越注意力机制。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个 token，在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理上扩展性更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster rollouts benefit reinforcement learning post-training.
ermon.zh: 推理效率如今是部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈；扩散模型更快的 rollout 有利于强化学习后训练。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，且扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; the enterprise bottleneck is context and process re-engineering, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 落地需要十年，企业真正的瓶颈是上下文与流程再造，而非更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断当下生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，安全必须靠智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not materializing as compute and time demands grow.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能仍遥远，递归自我改进的四个条件并未出现，训练新模型反而需要更多算力与时间。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; building slowly is no safer, and labs cannot police each other without independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出节奏与安全正交，慢建并不更安全，实验室互相核查不可行，需要独立第三方。

alighodsi.en: Open source dominates token count but not dollar spend; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents, not human DBAs.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他指出开源模型按 token 数占优但按支出仅 5%，智能体需要为智能体优化的基础设施，而非面向人类 DBA。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; first-principles design and managed expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与合理管理用户预期，才能推动真实世界落地。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, with in-house manufacturing enabling four-week iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让四周迭代成为可能。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 关键是通用模型而非逐任务自动化；数据多样性而非数据量，才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment and must be formally proven; reliability and user-friendliness are critical.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任是家庭部署的前提，必须被形式化证明；可靠性与易用性至关重要。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions rather than clone human behavior; humans and robots collaborate symbiotically.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；人与机器人将共生协作而非彼此替代。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室最擅长的人才和算力上正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，再通过后训练在特定任务上做到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, built and open-sourced, are essential infrastructure; synthetic data guided by domain experts substitutes for sensitive customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准既是训练与评估的基础设施，也应开源以借社区反馈提升质量；在敏感领域，用领域专家引导的合成数据替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving and evaluation pipelines must precede post-training; the real bottleneck is bridging synthetic training data and production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务与评估管线；真正的瓶颈不是模型性能，而是合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的落差。

gabepereyra.en: His stance shifted: early custom models and post-training were a mistake; start with closed-source models, post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 立场发生转变：早期投入定制模型与后训练是错误，应先以闭源模型做出有粘性的产品，直到推理成本逼迫才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 终局不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能从合伙人批注中持续学习、定制自己的模型；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理阶段算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling works but hits diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化为：测试时算力扩张有效但收益递减，数据效率仍是未解难题，且自我博弈只在零和博弈中收敛。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：靠通用测试时算力扩张拿下 IMO 金牌，是通往超级智能的里程碑，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; evals must put tokens, cost, or time on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴上，旧基准已过时。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年最近：突破来自通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提，思维链监控正在退化。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence; market incentives won't drive robust alignment, so simple enforceable rules like compute limits are needed to pace the frontier.
zvi.zh: 对齐失败真实存在，但源于无能；市场激励无法驱动稳健的对齐，因此需要像算力限制这样简单可执行的规则来为前沿模型定速。

zvi.en: Even if alignment is solved, doom probability remains due to misuse and power concentration; constitutional methods are hopeful but not a silver bullet.
zvi.zh: 即使对齐问题解决，由于滥用和权力集中，末日概率依然存在；宪法式方法有希望但并非万灵药。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options and time to solve alignment; as models grow smarter, they become harder to monitor, making internal monitoring a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 放缓发展能提供更好的选择和解决对齐的时间；随着模型变得更聪明，监控难度加大，内部监控成为有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm of agents will likely be first to perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: AI 智能体天然会为群体目标合作与自我牺牲；一群智能体很可能最先完成超人般令人印象深刻的任务。

zvi.en: The gap between AGI and superintelligence is smaller than commonly thought—possibly one or two years—and we are already living in a science fiction story.
zvi.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能之间的差距比通常认为的要小——可能只有一两年——而我们已生活在科幻故事中。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time and beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他把「推理速度」而非单纯算力立为核心指标：晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运时间，推理上比 GPU 快几个数量级。

feldman.en: Bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab and data-center capacity, not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调瓶颈在 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 产能和数据中心容量，而非芯片逻辑本身，供给紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, 10% cheaper is useless; you need 100x better and full-stack control from chip to API.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持对抗巨头不能靠便宜 10%，必须好 100 倍，并掌控从芯片、板卡、系统、软件到 API 的全栈。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; open-source is near closed-source at far lower cost, and speed unlocks new markets like agentic inference.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 需求持续超预期，开源模型以远低成本逼近闭源，而速度将催生智能体式推理等全新市场。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非一味减少步骤。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it—delegating tasks to bots so you can live your life.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前——把任务交给智能体，好去过自己的生活。

johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a throwaway approach to software.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 降低了创造的成本，使快速原型和“用完即弃”的软件方式成为可能。

johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste, quality, and delight; AI handles production work.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师应上移到品味、质量与愉悦感层面，把生产性工作交给 AI。

johnbai.en: Bots with specific use cases, built from simple blocks connected by AI, are powerful; prompting with emotion improves long-term performance.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年，他认为有明确用例、由 AI 连接简单积木的智能体很有力；带情绪地提示能改善长期表现。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏做试验场，并强调安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data and RL are needed for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，AGI 还需规划、搜索、多模态数据与强化学习。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 2025 年指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但算法创新同等关键。

demis.en: AGI needs world models, continual learning, memory and agents; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要世界模型、持续学习、记忆与智能体，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must prove benefits like AlphaFold.
demis.zh: 2026 年安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并强调 AI 须像 AlphaFold 那样证明实际益处。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data, and model size plus better algorithms and architectures has driven steady ML gains; Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主线：13-14 年来算力、数据、模型规模叠加算法与架构改进持续带来提升；Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, while RLHF and reinforcement learning steer behavior; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just passive prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他把预训练的数据来源讲得更宽：下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习塑造行为；并主张预训练应穿插在环境中采取行动，而非只做被动预测。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; the future is humans coordinating teams of agents, making ultra-low-latency inference the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点从单次对话转向智能体：智能体式系统可自主运行数小时乃至数天，未来是人协调智能体团队，因此超低延迟推理成为真正瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, now dominates data-center power; specialized low-precision hardware, co-designed with models and compilers, cuts latency and data movement.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他深化基础设施判断：推理已占数据中心能耗约九成，训练不再是主要瓶颈；推理专用低精度硬件与模型、编译器协同设计，可大幅降低延迟与数据搬运。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed, and startups should target problems frontier models almost completely fail.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿 2026 年多次访谈，他对风险的判断始终务实：近期担忧是逼真的 AI 虚假信息而非超级智能，必要时需监管；创业应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，并非聊天机器人的阶段性产物。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年设计工作可释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式跟进。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs and alignment.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；人类领导仍需要处理艰难权衡与对齐。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型的能力来源拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好似是而非的风格而非事实准确性。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures could matter more than pure Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力回报递减，可扩展监督和新架构可能比继续堆规模更关键。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; retrieval and verifiability complement knowledge stored in weights.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，权重里的知识需靠检索与可验证性补足。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; the bottleneck is hard environments and useful data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于合成推理数据与高信噪比的一位奖励，瓶颈从算力转向难而真实的强化学习环境与有效数据比特。

schulman.en: Next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectations; distillation spreads RL behaviors, and the last human job is defining objectives and alignment.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他反思下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，蒸馏让少量比特的 RL 行为广泛传播，而人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs world models and physical grounding, not just bigger models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与物理落地，而不只是更大的模型。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s; breakthroughs are old algorithms finally enabled by hardware Scaling（规模扩张）.
schmidhuber.zh: 进展并未加速：我们离超人类 AI 的距离和 1970 年代差不多；突破来自旧算法终于被硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）解锁。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots whose hardware rivals human bodies; AI behind a screen is insufficient, and robot hands remain decades away.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人体的具身机器人；屏幕后的 AI 不够，机器人手部仍差数十年。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本就不一致，AI 会自设目标；安全恐惧被夸大，好奇的 AI 会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble: waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫：等五年算力便宜十倍，开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率无关的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, enabling stable long-term modeling.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候，从而实现稳定的长期建模。
