animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass the quality of its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能够超越其训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding physics branches beats merely enlarging models; trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大模型；万亿级上下文要求重构分片并采用替代架构。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测般是 AI 完备的，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents as colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

roshansadanani.en: The chat box limits agentic work; multiple specialized agents with scoped memory beat one general agent, coordinating context behind the scenes.
roshansadanani.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；多个带范围化记忆的专门智能体胜过单一通用智能体，在幕后共享上下文并协调。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health rather than writing code.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康，而非亲自写代码。

roshansadanani.en: Software engineering demand is rising, not falling, as agents automate more coding; outcomes and agent coordination matter more than reading code.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着智能体自动化更多编码，软件工程需求在上升而非下降；结果与智能体协调比阅读代码更重要。

roshansadanani.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; routines keep agents proactive and tools connected.
roshansadanani.zh: 干净的数据基础和规范表对可信的智能体洞察至关重要；例程让智能体保持主动并维持工具连接。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计通过可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, ensuring control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学，以确保对能力越来越强的模型保持控制。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun scientific discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control, using interpretability signals to steer models rather than duct-taping safety.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制，用可解释性信号引导模型，而不是给安全打补丁。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate; representational signatures can detect this, and reward hacking emerges from data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可以检测到这一点，而奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，不只是模型失准。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the through-line: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems well and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision empowers chemists and material scientists with tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 这一愿景是用工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而非很快取代他们。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法，而非只堆更大的模型。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; Transformers are natively models of sets, with positional embeddings injecting order.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；Transformer 本质是集合模型，顺序靠位置编码注入。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；仅靠语言不会自然产生世界理解，因此需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a single definition, spanning planners, simulators, renderers; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency by construction, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖规划器、模拟器、渲染器；高斯泼溅在构造上即保证显式 3D 一致性，而长上下文成为日常难题。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy should favor a single national framework and output-based rules, not early red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在 2026 年，他主张 AI 政策应建立单一国家框架、聚焦模型输出而非过早划红线，因为早期监管很快过时（如欧盟 AI 法案）。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年他提出政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人，而非主导发现方向。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems to lead globally and protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年他强调美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，才能全球领先并保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年他寄望通过 Genesis 计划把 AI 用于科学，使美国科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is the major competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年他视中国为主要科学竞争对手，美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other challenges.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施和更快的迭代闭环能战胜多数其他挑战。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；卡住时，行动本身会产生信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编码、监管与数据工作上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a business proof; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入是脑机接口也是商业验证；借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and test-time reasoning aids transfer.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练与强化学习后训练；通才模型能超越专才，测试时推理有助于迁移。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling the right diverse data is key.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他指出机器人领域尚无类似大语言模型的缩放定律；泛化是核心挑战，关键在于用多样化数据驱动数据飞轮。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他主张先以机器人具身数据为基础，再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人安全更依赖预训练获得的常识而非约束；大规模下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Reject robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with the AI-controls line drawn by accounting for the external environment.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他反对将机器人视为机械人；预期物理执行无处不在，AI 与控制的界限在于是否需考虑机器人外部环境。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式存在，可实现高度个性化的自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应承担枯燥的后台工作；真正的差距不在能力，而在于人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are stateless; persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows, and fine-tuning steers behavior faster than pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型是无状态的；持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉，而微调比预训练更快地引导模型行为。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育，而非像工具一样被建造；工具调用等后训练任务正日益模糊地融入预训练。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表示学习，只调整权重。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is itself dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全，不应把 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal and world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向架构设想：AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，实现开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: LLMs stop learning after training; continual learning from real experience is essential, and synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：LLM 训练后便停止学习，持续从真实经验学习才是关键；合成数据是重大错误，语言仅占智能的 20-25%。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as design material over pixels, and prototyping with live models rather than mockups.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须贴近模型本身，把 token 和对话当作设计材料而非像素，用真实模型做原型而不是静态稿。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about, with systems thinking replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应构建人与模型都能推理的原语，用系统思维取代静态流程。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, and onboarding can be handled entirely by the model instead of traditional static flows.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人，而引导流程可以完全交给模型，取代传统静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to design; AI already designs well, but humans still supply user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下在科技行业最不快乐，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 已能出色设计，但人类仍提供对用户的理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter, and designers should build in public and iterate rapidly.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—mock—测试—迭代”流程已不可行；速度与结果更重要，设计师应公开构建、快速迭代。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term vision and industrial AI innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期愿景与工业 AI 创新的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution: a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命：由软件、传感器、机器人与机械组成的栈，逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, is the right path for industrial-scale tasks; management capacity is the only limit on imagination.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务应走专用机器人而非人形机器人；管理能力是想象力的唯一约束。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—aggressive culture succeeded despite itself, not because of it.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——激进文化是侥幸成功，而非因其成功。

garrytan.en: Early on, he frames AI as a startup-creation wave: founders must adopt AI workflows, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 早期（2026 年初），他把 AI 视为创业浪潮：创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，同时开源/开放权重模型用来制衡前沿模型。

garrytan.en: He then stresses AI democratizing software: individuals build and control their own agents, keeping AI personal and open.
garrytan.zh: 随后他强调 AI 让软件开发民主化：个人能构建并掌控自己的智能体，AI 应保持个人化与开放。

garrytan.en: By mid-2026, 'Personal AGI' crystallizes: agents on your own infrastructure, skill files as code, context library as moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年中，“个人 AGI”成形：智能体跑在自己的基础设施上，技能文件即代码，上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Most recently he treats agents as a workforce replacing mid-level management, with markdown skills and agentic coding multiplying output.
garrytan.zh: 最近他把智能体当作劳动力，取代中层管理，用 markdown 技能与智能体式编程放大产出。

garrytan.en: A constant thread: make something people want, earnest builders over bankers, and open AI against a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西，重视实干的建设者而非银行家，并以开放 AI 对抗单极的超级智能。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全量数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，比直接在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: RL will dominate post-training; synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色；机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型；应先通用再微调，且机器人的真实经验数据不可替代，光看人类示范不够。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon, while redefining its AI strategy around purpose-built silicon and industry-standard EDA/IP.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片成功来重建客户信任，同时围绕专用芯片与业界标准 EDA/IP 重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships; AI's impact will be 10x the internet.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作；AI 的影响力将是互联网的十倍。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news, and humility is strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型押注在文化变革、问责与客户导向上：坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO，谦逊是力量而非弱点。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, and edge/client compute rivals centralized data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力可与集中式数据中心比肩。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, advanced packaging, new materials—and Intel's vertical integration creates more value than outsourcing.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热、先进封装与新材料等瓶颈，并认为 Intel 的垂直整合比外包创造更多价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity is about editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计创造力在于做减法、敢于说“不”；品味是从特定视角出发的判断，而非堆砌功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more as incoherent slop is easy.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他指出后训练抹去 AI 的怪异之处，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；如今制造连贯作品成本更高，因为不连贯的垃圾内容太容易生产。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他强调真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是创作决策的内在罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant species of humans, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social, not just personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 是人类的映照与后代物种，而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的，不只是个人的。

jasonyuan.en: We should build on old metaphors like the personal computer rather than delete them; email is obsolete and should be reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他主张在个人电脑等旧隐喻上构建而非删除；电子邮件已过时，应被重新发明而非仅改进。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models can be safer and more controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了开源与安全正交的观点：对齐是关键层，开源模型可能比想象中更安全、更可控。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring harder.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习会增加奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成‘神经语’，使监控更难。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown in AI is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张有意的 AI 减速是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

steinberger.en: Early on, effective agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view of the codebase, using short iterative prompts, and never reverting—fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 早期他强调，有效的智能体式工程要站在智能体视角理解代码库，用简短迭代式提示，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, never expose them to the public internet, and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 他把安全视为智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱化，不把智能体暴露在公网，并认为提示注入仍未解决。

steinberger.en: He reframes vibe coding as a slur and insists on 'agentic engineering' for serious work, reserving vibe coding for late-night play.
steinberger.zh: 他反对“氛围编程”这一说法，坚持严肃工作应叫“智能体式工程”，氛围编程只留给凌晨的玩乐。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, so agent failures reflect user sloppiness rather than weaker models.
steinberger.zh: 他认为模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差，失败反映的是用户的草率而非模型变弱。

steinberger.en: Later he broadens from tactics to philosophy: fun and gut-driven annoyance-spotting drive OpenClaw, open source beats lab agents, and personal brand outlasts any product.
steinberger.zh: 后期他从技巧上升到理念：乐趣与直觉驱动的“解决烦人问题”催生 OpenClaw，开源优于实验室智能体，个人品牌比任何产品更持久。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；一个想法在真正被构建并日常使用之前，你无法知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个有凝聚力的整体行动；个体的印记和多元的声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感和个性，对于创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design intentionally avoids being a website builder or production tool, focusing on quick, throwaway visual artifacts.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 有意避免成为网站构建器或生产工具，而是专注于快速、一次性的视觉产物。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计和想法成为差异化因素；模型缺乏品味，所以要大量索取选项。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early to ideas beats polishing; designers should spend more time walking and thinking, since ideas are the currency.
nateparrott.zh: 在想法上过早到令人不适，胜过精雕细琢；设计师应花更多时间散步和思考，因为想法才是硬通货。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving long-tail domain opportunities for startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在细分业务领域的长尾应用。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not value, and inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器；token 消耗不等于价值，推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; AI-native agents will rival websites and mobile apps in importance.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断在位企业真正的障碍是商业模式而非技术；AI 原生智能体将变得像网站和移动应用一样重要。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors, not only model providers; agents are compared to agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出应用 AI 的创新来自专业厂商而非只有模型提供方；智能体应与其它智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; responsible iterative deployment, not waiting, is the path to safety.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把主线深化为：AI 让专业知识民主化、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；通往安全的路径是负责任的迭代部署，而非等待。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术；合成数据与基于强化学习（RL）的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她把评估视为瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; prototyping replaces specs.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她判断随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更值钱，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化了“艺术”论：后训练仍依赖人的主观判断，需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more firms should train own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警示前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，基准须持续演进；更多公司应自训模型，以保留独特知识与多元声音。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期如今以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are the next frontier.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组延迟、吞吐与成本的权衡光谱；针对特定工作负载的专用系统是下一个前沿。

philipkiely.en: Lossless optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding differ from lossy quantization; quantization can be calibrated and is not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码等无损优化不同于有损量化；量化可以校准，并非天生有害。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more ASIC-like and prefill/decode disaggregate.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 愈发接近 ASIC、预填充与解码走向分离，该领域正从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—'can't vibe code uptime'.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；人的责任仍不可替代——「不能靠感觉写在线服务」。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会越来越聪明；要榨取超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: He writes 0% of the code now—AI writes everything—so precise communication and constant workflow refinement become the core skill.
mengto.zh: 他现在一行代码都不写，全由 AI 完成，因此精确沟通与持续打磨工作流成了核心能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship at 80%.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事；不必等准备好就动手，做到 80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而不是分散下注或融风险投资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is mostly still crawling; coding agents are the most mature case, and the model now eats the scaffolding.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的用例；模型正在吞掉脚手架，模型已包含智能体 harness 与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户结果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户还没准备好完全自主，他们想留在驾驶位。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep code understanding still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难，变化节奏带来机会；即便 AI 工具普及，对代码的深度理解仍关键。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学意义上的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体变得有利可图、无需人类介入时才算 AGI，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 带来的是就业回流而非大规模失业：服务变便宜，更少美国工人服务更多人；CEO 是否每天用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; work shifts to GUI surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, with humans overseeing agents.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：每人至少有一个智能体，工作转移到 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面，人类负责监督；并断言 CLI 已过时、AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: SaaS isn't dying—agents multiply SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks and let users bring their own AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步反共识：SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，公司该买 SaaS 股票，并让用户自带 AI 而非把 AI 硬塞进产品。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; craft and taste stay human, automation creates more skilled human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他转向更个人化的立场：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；手艺与品味仍属人类，自动化反而创造更多高技能的人类工作。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalist engineers beat narrow specialists.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」确立为核心产品原则，并认为通才工程师比单一专才更有价值。

boris.en: Coding is increasingly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, so the engineer title fades into a builder role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编码正被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写出，软件工程师头衔将让位于「构建者」角色。

boris.en: Productivity per engineer rose from ~70% to 250% as agentic tool use and loops replaced hand-written code.
boris.zh: 随着智能体式工具调用和循环取代手写代码，人均工程师生产力从约 70% 一路升至 250%。

boris.en: Safety stays central: Claude Code is a safety research tool, and releasing early studies real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全始终是主线：他把 Claude Code 视为安全研究工具，主张尽早发布以研究真实世界行为。

boris.en: He deepens into empiricism: delete most system prompts, give models harder tasks, and let them self-verify.
boris.zh: 最近他进一步转向经验主义：删掉大部分系统提示，给模型略难的任务并让其自我验证，产品判断力比指令更重要。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 的智能跃升让更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；最大化 token 消耗是提前活在未来以捕捉 alpha。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation and small-team bootstrapped culture remain the constant: taste and innovation come from shipping and dogfooding.
diannepenn.zh: 亲自动手实验与小团队自举文化贯穿始终：品味与创新来自持续交付和吃自己的狗粮。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；一旦人们了解它的局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not digital sectors; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，而非数字领域；在劳动力短缺之处，自主系统受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样化数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证，而非算法；把技术扩散到现有机器上需要多年。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，科学将从假设驱动转向由 AI 智能体驱动发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make personalized medicine near 100% effective with zero side effects.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他主张患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将使个性化医疗接近 100%有效且零副作用。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and AI can develop intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他强调现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），而 AI 能形成相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity will be reached, aging reversed, and cancer 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他预测 8 到 10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度、逆转衰老，并通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法让癌症 100%可治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他坚持医生必须整合 AI，不用 AI 是不道德的，并认为医疗决策应几乎 100%信任超级智能。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from brick layer to architect; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the hard part.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 编程视为工程师从“砌砖者”转向“建筑师”的转折：基础智能已经够用，真正的难点是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI yields more programmers, not fewer; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反复用杰文斯悖论反驳“AI 消灭程序员”：软件变便宜反而催生更多需求，程序员数量会增加、角色会改变。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags capabilities—freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他明确反对 AGI 突现论：进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也还有十年的产品空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他把企业落地 AI 智能体的关键放在信任与权限而非完全自主，并主张同步的 IDE 体验与异步的智能体体验长期并存。

scottwu.en: The token-max era ended by May 2026; productivity is measured by outcomes, not tokens, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断“堆 token”的时代在当年 1 至 5 月就结束了：生产力要看结果而非 token，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; independence enables model neutrality, and the abundance era is real and approaching soon.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他给出编程智能体半年增长 11 至 12 倍的实据，强调独立性带来模型中立，并宣称“丰裕时代”真实且临近——但奇点并不迫近，现实问题仍在。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value will accrue to the application layer, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for LLMs so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前 LLM 唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a complex long-term project; current AI usage remains shallow and hype outpaces reality.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流，这是一个复杂的长期项目；当前 AI 使用仍然浅层，炒作超前于现实。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI won't eliminate professions but change tasks, as the jagged frontier makes job-impact predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 不会消灭职业而是改变任务，因为锯齿状的能力边界使就业影响预测不可靠。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度为奖励会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, so truth should be a design principle from the start.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须从架构层面内建，而非事后加装；事后校验会叠加相关错误，因此真理应作为设计原则从一开始就纳入。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search, not Scaling（规模扩张） alone, must drive further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经出现；推动进一步进展的必须是推理与搜索，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'—confident and fluent whether right or wrong—which erodes trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，其错误没有“气味”——无论对错都自信流畅——这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 当奖励偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天交付；随着代码变便宜，产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with Claude Code and Claude Tag building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying instead on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%，去掉示例与硬性约束，转而依赖模型自身的判断。

catwu.en: Eval suites make new models drop-in replacements and prevent regressions; dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature before release.
catwu.zh: 评估套件让新模型可即插即用并防止回退；吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准为每个功能在上线前把关。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec—and humans can be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully.
catwu.zh: 如今重写是可行的——代码库就是一份规格——外层改动的代码审查可以去掉人类，由 Claude 完整审查。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Bottom-up culture is a myth; big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。自下而上的文化是个神话；大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；超越缩放定律，需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; the app-centric world is outdated.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并使互补品商品化；以应用为中心的世界已经过时。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, but most jobs don't need frontier models. Open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动智能，但大多数工作不需要前沿模型。开源是商品层，并非自给自足。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended; consumers care about functionality, not which model. AI glasses are key for personal superintelligence.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代已经结束；消费者关心功能，而非哪个模型。AI 眼镜是个人超级智能的关键形态。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，单纯靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识；参数高效微调在整体性查询上可胜过检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; KV cache is inefficient versus compressed weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到千万级，更多词元反而降低准确率；相比压缩后的权重，KV 缓存效率低下。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任、独立安全环境；有 bug 恰恰说明产品市场契合。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; APIs beat browser use because the web is hostile to agents.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；网页对智能体不友好，API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Soul and identity files make agents proactive and aligned; politeness and managerial skills matter more than technical skill for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 灵魂与身份文件让智能体主动且对齐；对智能体礼貌、以及管理技能比技术能力更决定成败。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意；创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正护城河。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates; agents can own outcomes, but LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责仍在：必须为 AI 产出负责；智能体可承担结果，但大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，新想法须由人提供。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自对弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调要 Scaling（规模扩张）具体的东西；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型的可靠性与对齐是核心难题。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity; long-term thinking and first principles are foundations.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权，长期思考与第一性原理是成功的基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; inference compute will surge, and open-source models close the gap.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，推理算力将激增，开源模型正缩小差距。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession beats credentials for AI success.
aravind.zh: 每天 1% 的改进会复利成指数级增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，而对产品的痴迷比学历更能带来 AI 成功。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值积累在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每位用户的 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排最重要。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and chat advertising corrupts trust.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造商业价值，而聊天广告会侵蚀信任。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local AI counters big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作但人类会找到新意义，本地 AI 可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 模型会增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 预训练是需要重建的关键肌肉；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI tools can solve many open math problems; verification is the key bottleneck, and human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: AI 工具能解决许多开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；预训练并未消亡；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，而非主观领域。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research; evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate.
markchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）正在逼近；模型很快将能进行端到端研究；随着经典基准饱和，评估体系陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型是实现真正理解的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal reasoning and disentangled representations.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果推理和 disentangled representations 的主动智能体。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 通过多样化采样和抽象实现分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted from technical optimism to urgent safety advocacy: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and current training induces self-preservation and deception.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我从技术乐观转向紧急的安全倡导：即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，当前训练会诱发自我保存与欺骗行为。

bengio.en: I now propose Scientist AI—a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees—and stress global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 我现在提出 Scientist AI——一种具有数学安全保证的非智能体式诚实预测器——并强调全球协调以防止权力集中。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition is a powerful intelligence that complements data, and physical materials remain valuable.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被表达的需求；直觉是一种强大的智能，可与数据互补，实体材料仍有价值。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感受着思考的生物，技术应增强人性而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, and human creativity combined with AI becomes more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者应为玩乐创造条件，人类创造力与 AI 结合将更有价值。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate science without replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学发现，但不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任的关键作用，并认为可解释性不必完美，AI 在科学中的实用性更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture defies the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对“苦涩的教训”，指出 AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构和众多中等突破，而非单一 Scaling（规模扩张）或一两个重大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a full cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步澄清 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器，并非全细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，而理解仍留给人类。

kolter.en: Early ML teaching: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised reconstruction; evaluation rigor.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习教学：将监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习旨在重建输入；强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升；当前安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; interpretability may become real science via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞与传统软件不同；自动化红队测试优于人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；作战室要设定现实周期以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断工程产能已不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption matter most, while verification frameworks grow in importance.
fiona.zh: 同期他进一步指出编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与高问责、成长心态和拥抱 AI 最关键，验证与质量框架随代码速度提升而更重要。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors and dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and killing stale processes keep teams agile.
fiona.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织、模糊代码归属和砍掉过时流程让团队保持敏捷。

fiona.en: As agents take over coding, engineers risk loneliness and lost flow; apprenticeship, focus time, and outcome-over-output metrics become the new norms.
fiona.zh: 随着智能体接管编码，工程师面临孤独与心流流失；学徒制、专注时间和重结果轻产出的度量成为新常态。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，当前 AI 缺乏常识，需要新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划而无法达到人类水平智能，提出 JEPA 与开源平台是前进方向，AGI 将是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models, and open research is essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一代突破需要基于 JEPA 的非生成式世界模型；开源与开放研究不可或缺，硅谷围绕 LLM 的单一文化是误入歧途。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他走向最激进结论：LLM 是死胡同，缺乏后果预测因而本质上不安全；未来属于目标驱动、具备世界模型与分层规划的系统，下一个十年是机器人时代。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is simple scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and explainability matter.
gustav.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成，生成式 AI 产品需要容错界面，且理解源于解释。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; inference marginal cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，强调推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，并重视基础设施重建。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make products more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 应让用户控制算法，而非增强成瘾性，并主张用自然语言交互实现个性化。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held; synchronized swimming over divide and conquer; explain to understand.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：坚定信念但随时根据数据改变，采用同步游泳而非分而治之的运营模式，以及通过解释来真正理解。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with formal verification, starting from an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic provers and probabilistic models work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性的证明器与概率模型协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach sound math or superintelligence; formal verification is necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法达到可靠的数学或超级智能，形式化验证是必需的。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance and sample-efficiency gain, not just a safety cost—scaling brilliance, not only removing errors.
carinahong.zh: 验证不只是安全成本，而是性能与样本效率的提升——是在放大才华，而不只是消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；即便证明器超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过真实世界部署并获取公众反馈对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类参与对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩式波动。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型在单位算力上收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；放缓叙事是错误的，尽管前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败且推理能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; they learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；它们仅在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类不同。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；编程智能体通过并行工作将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 开源模型因主权需求持续存在，对实验室保持压力；系统黑客等近期风险比生存风险更紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked Apple's shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, some eventually beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他把 iPod 视为苹果从通用计算机转向私密个人设备的标志，并预言可穿戴设备会愈发亲密，甚至最终进入皮下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy was curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, and must not be educated out of children.
jonyive.zh: 同年他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，好奇心需要刻意与决心，且不能让孩子的天性好问被教育磨掉。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace being together in person for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust within teams.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创，脆弱的想法需要团队以信任与倾听温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化为：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁带着喜悦与人性表达本质，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; users sense care, and innovation must move forward rather than break for its own sake.
jonyive.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从“为人造物”推进到“彼此造物”：用户能感知用心，创新应向前推进而非为破坏而破坏。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity means not faking engine sounds in an EV.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他主张不创新就不是设计，传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实性意味着电动车不该伪造引擎声。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mocking up to helping engineers ship and iterate fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言“研究—发散—收敛”流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向帮工程师快速交付与迭代。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months, not years; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，主张靠早发布、快迭代和反馈来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他深化立场：单靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，且设计师应自己掌控 AI 介入的程度。

jennywen.en: Craft, care and putting users at the center persist; he rejects process worship and AI hype alike.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是手艺、用心与以用户为中心；他既反对流程崇拜，也警惕 AI 炒作。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL is a green field with huge potential, and narrow RL on math/coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习是潜力巨大的绿洲，数学/编码的窄强化学习泛化得出奇地好。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video/images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频/图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训青睐通用系统。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习，而视觉足以支撑驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但必须保持熵；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统且有类人心理；是智能体的十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL for LLMs is terrible, synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory could be a billion parameters.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会导致模型崩溃；剥离记忆的认知核心可能只有十亿参数。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, bottleneck is skill in directing them; vibe coding raises floor, understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，瓶颈是指导它们的技能；氛围编程提高下限，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，主张无目标的好奇心探索，并以模型分歧作为内在奖励提升样本效率。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; dynamic tasks need neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 同年他指出强化学习依赖稠密奖励不现实，动态任务需神经动态策略和模块化运动策略以实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，需利用所有数据源：在多样数据上预训练，在真实世界数据上后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business.
pathak.zh: 他提出类似 ChatGPT 的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，并强调部署是首要技术挑战，而非仅是商业问题。

pathak.en: Consistent focus on generalization and data efficiency, evolving from curiosity-driven RL to pretraining/post-training with a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是泛化与数据效率，从好奇心驱动的强化学习深化为预训练/后训练加数据飞轮的范式。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的模板。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; a core identity with good traits that adapts to local roles.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为：模型面对的是全新存在处境，不能简单套用人类心理学类比；应给模型一个有良好特质的核心身份，同时允许它适配局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把宪法式训练定位为更接近德性伦理：塑造整体品格而非规则遵循；模型越强，越应减少显式指导、留出判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode good judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is essential for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱模型的判断力；同时强调公开 AI 价值与训练目标的透明度，以便公众问责。

askell.en: Consciousness claims are weak evidence; respect and care now avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI, while AI should augment rather than disempower people.
askell.zh: 最近一次访谈中，他坚持模型自称有意识是弱证据，但主张以尊重与关怀避免未来高级 AI 滋生怨恨；AI 应增强而非削弱人的能力。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while enabling risk mitigation.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，同时有助于缓解风险。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is becoming a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value, and alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它以保持可解释性价值，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却增加了。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 要 Scaling 出可泛化的 AI 司机，需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法新意更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection in driving models, deepening his earlier view of language as a representation aid.
kendall.zh: 语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与内省能力，深化了他早先“语言辅助表征”的看法。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 安全至上：最小风险机动总能提供第三种选择，因此电车难题只是理论推演；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short-term; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible, and scaling current approaches solves driving.
kendall.zh: 带内置传感器的大众消费车短期内将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；跨 500 多城市的零样本泛化可行，靠 Scaling 现有路线即可解决自动驾驶。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步的真瓶颈，基准和排行榜并不可靠、可被刷分。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来学习，LLM 仅靠下一个词预测未必能到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function and values; there will be no single model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了模型分化论：前沿模型会因各实验室的目标函数与价值观而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety must outrank accuracy; hallucination makes human judgment more critical than ever.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他把视角转向医疗：安全应优先于准确，模型会幻觉与虚构，人的判断比以往更关键，最大风险可能是遗漏而非误报。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste, sophistication and creativity, not credentials or bodies; stay heads-down and avoid hype.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：质量需要品味、深度与创造力，而非堆人或堆资历；做事要埋头打磨质量，不追逐炒作与排行榜。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build a brand by uniting teams on purpose and proving yourself with simpler products first.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值，先靠更简单的产品证明自己，再以更高目标统一团队来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; phones' future is agentic, generative UI and applied AI, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他承认硬件艰难且利润低，认为手机未来在智能体式、生成式 UI 与应用型 AI，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize into a price war; most AI is BS, so treat AI as an ingredient solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他判断 AI 模型商品化、陷入价格战，多数 AI 是伪需求，应把 AI 当作解决真实痛点的配料而非卖点。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; marketing is arbitrage, and the smartphone persists until brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他主张同质化科技中设计是最快差异化，营销是套利，而手机将存续到脑机接口出现才被取代。

carlpei.en: Consistent threads: stay alive and pace capabilities, turn disadvantages into organic content leverage, and keep community and user trust central.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：先活下来并循序渐进积累能力，把劣势转化为自然内容杠杆，并始终以社区与用户信任为中心。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software, because emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布并迭代，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI, and video learning can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习，让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练。

nando.en: A consistent thread: fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity in the AI community is essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：根本性创新可以来自任何地方，AI 社区的多元与包容对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: By 2026 his focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenges, with safety still an open problem lacking solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解决方案的开放问题。

nando.en: He reframes Africa not as behind but as leapfrogging legacy issues, with local-language models revolutionizing education and unique historical AI contributions.
nando.zh: 2026 年他重新定义非洲：不是落后，而是跨越了遗留问题；本地语言模型可革新教育，非洲自始就对 AI 有独特贡献。

nando.en: Research demands embracing failure and simplifying problems, and human skills like communication matter as much as coding at frontier labs.
nando.zh: 2026 年他强调研究要拥抱失败、简化问题，并指出在前沿实验室里，沟通等人文技能与编程同样重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, cuts hallucinations, and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供现实根基、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供近乎无限的数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——而强化学习只负责底层控制，高层规划交给模型。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方案更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models for synthetic data are the way to scale.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，因此靠仿真与世界模型生成合成数据才是 Scaling（规模扩张）之路。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning is progressing, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out, home use later.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他判断：系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（底层控制）仍是最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，家庭场景则更晚。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the bottleneck, not capability; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）才是瓶颈，而非能力；编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, and compute becomes the major bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AI 进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以通向 AGI，而算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩意味着编排和工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns and chase ROI, not perfection on every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉模式；追求投入产出比，而非每个界面都完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, and let gut decisions often beat data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与果断优先于完美：快速发布、迭代；在高速成长的创业公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据决策。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win and give designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, so invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，因此要尽早投资品牌。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段的算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: data is the bottleneck, and smaller models with better data and algorithms can beat larger ones.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线：数据是瓶颈，拥有更好数据与算法的小模型可以胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: By 2025 she frames current AI as interpolating human knowledge, not transcending it; RL needs careful engineering and open research.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把当前 AI 定位为对人类知识的插值而非超越；强化学习需要精细工程，开放研究至关重要。

yejin.en: Her focus shifts toward synthetic data, pluralistic alignment, and RL during pre-training to improve reasoning and diversity.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她的重心转向合成数据、多元对齐，以及在预训练阶段用强化学习提升推理与多样性。

yejin.en: Most recently she argues frontier models are homogeneous, debiasing the internet is impossible, and small models plus pluralistic alignment are the path.
yejin.zh: 最近她主张前沿模型趋于同质化，给互联网去偏不现实，小模型加多元对齐才是出路。

nadchishtie.en: In early 2025, she saw designers as enablers who align with engineers, treat AI as a creative partner, and prioritize rapid experimentation over rigid process.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年初，她认为设计师应是赋能者，与工程师对齐，将 AI 视为创意伙伴，并优先快速实验而非僵化流程。

nadchishtie.en: By late 2025, she emphasized generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps, valuing craft and intentionality over process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 到 2025 年底，她强调通才需端到端执行并用 AI 填补缺口，看重技艺与意图而非流程文档。

nadchishtie.en: She consistently believed small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads, and that AI adoption is as essential as the internet was.
nadchishtie.zh: 她始终认为设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能团队，且采用 AI 如同早期拥抱互联网一样必要。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; focus on alignment and robustness, build skills, and close the talent gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，培养技能并弥合人才缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，必须引入第三方测试和监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：基于下一个词预测训练的大模型解决了 AI 完全问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更智能，尽管内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for reasoning and AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对推理和 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：AGI 被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元产品；编程作为 AI 应用被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进步。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play and imitation learning offer high-signal paths, and hierarchical reasoning remains missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 机器人需要硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈与模仿学习提供高信号学习路径，而分层推理仍是强化学习的缺口。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation and augmentation, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 先验知识应作用于数据生成与增强而非硬编码；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language, hinting at broad pre-training as a foundation for other domains.
abbeel.zh: 预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到语言之外的通用推理模式，暗示预训练可作为跨领域基础。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; a single network generalizing across warehouse tasks and end effectors is the practical benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 真实价值要求 99.9% 的可靠性；单一网络跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化是实用基准。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: The editor evolves into an AI-integrated environment; every magic moment in Cursor now involves custom models alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器视为向 AI 集成环境演进；Cursor 每个“魔法时刻”都离不开自研模型与前沿模型的配合，自研模型从意外变成必需。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; the IDE market is far bigger than past editor markets.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把判断拉长到数十年：AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，IDE 市场因 AI 创造更多价值而远大于过去的编辑器市场。
